name: review-production-readiness
prompt: Review a .NET 10 WPF repository for production readiness, including architecture, reliability, accessibility, localization, deployment, updates, and diagnostics.
rubric: Orders evidence-backed findings by severity and avoids generic advice.
Covers Windows-specific startup, shutdown, DPI, theme, accessibility, localization, publish, installer, and rollback checks.
Clearly separates static review, build results, automated tests, and pending manual validation.
